IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO.517/2025
ABHISHEK RAJENDRA PATEL ...APPLICANT
VS
STATE OF MAHARASHTRA AND ANR. ...RESPONDENTS
…
Adv. Ranjeet H Patil for the Applicant.
Adv. Ajay S. Patil, APP for the Respondent State.
…
CORAM : RAJESH S. PATIL, J.  
DATED : APRIL 16, 2025
P .C.:
1. Not on board. Upon mentioning, taken on board.
2. Mr. Patil, learned counsel for the applicant, on instructions
of the applicant submits that the applicant has already been arrested.
Therefore,  the  present  pre-arrest  bail  application  has  become
infructuous.
3. Anticipatory bail application is disposed off as infructuous.
(RAJESH S. PATIL, J.)
1
Harish
